text:
mira: Heads-up: seeing structured JSON outputs break and sporadic hallucinations after the latest quant calibration roll. Repro on staging with INT8+mixprec routing. Posting quick perf/log snippets.

alex: Can you paste the failing prompt + repro command?

mira: repro command: `./run_inference --model=redwood-mix-2b --quant=INT8 --prompt-file=tests/structured/req-17.json --profile=kernel`

failing prompt (trimmed): `{"user":"get_user","id":1234,"fields":["name","emails"]}`
output (expected): `{"user":{"id":1234,"name":"...","emails":[...]}}`
output (observed): `{"user":{"id":1234,"name":"...","emails":null`  <-- truncated/malformed + extra hallucinated sentence appended

sam: grabbed perf traces 2hrs ago. p50 token latency for int8 path +9ms vs fp32, p95 +40ms. batcher shows lots of 1-sized batches when KV cache miss rate spikes. Kernel selection: tried int8-kernel-v3 -> got kernel-fallback to fp32-kernel at runtime for several layers (log below).

sam: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T15:22:11Z] kernel_select: model=redwood-mix-2b seq=512 layer=17 preferred=int8-kv-v3 chosen=fp32-fallback reason=scale_overflow
[2026-03-18T15:22:11Z] quantizer: layer=17 scale=2.1e+38 overflow=true
[2026-03-18T15:22:12Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.27 batcher.active=12 -> batching_window reduced
```

jin: we flipped `per_layer_bias_correction: true` in the calibration config in the release at commit `c4f9b2d` two hours before incident. That changes scale compute and would explain scale_overflow events for certain layer activations.

ci-bot: Deploy `release/quant-calib/c4f9b2d` to staging succeeded at 2026-03-18T13:18:04Z.

mira: also noticing that structured outputs degrade when the runtime toggles kernel mid-inference (int8 -> fp32 within same request). The KV cache layout differs between kernels causing position/offset mismatch in some JSON generation paths.

alex: rough mitigation: force consistent kernel per request (fall back at routing level) or make kernel switcher enforce KV cache compatibility. Quick flag: `runtime.force_single_kernel=true` should avoid mid-request switching. Can we enable on staging?

ops-bot: `runtime.force_single_kernel=true` enabled on staging (auto rollout to 5% hosts) at 15:40 UTC. Watch for perf regressions.

sam: did that. When forced, structured JSON stops truncating but p50 goes up ~12ms and token throughput drops. Need better long-term fix.

mira: sample diff of outputs (sanitized):
```
- {"user":{"id":1234,"name":"Mira","emails":["mira@corp.com"]}}
+ {"user":{"id":1234,"name":"Mira","emails":null "Also check the attached note about billing"}
```
Note: hallucinated sentence appended into JSON field.

jin: hypothesis: mixed-precision path uses different KV packing and we didn't update `kv-index-pad` or `kv-offset` when enabling per-layer bias correction; small desyncs produce truncated tokens mid-structured tokens. Also scale_overflow triggers fallback -> inconsistent state.

alex: actionable triage list:
- roll back `per_layer_bias_correction` in calibration and re-run calibration job (mira+jin)
- add eval-suite test for structured JSON prompts under forced kernel flip conditions (sam)
- add telemetry: count kernel switches per request + verify kv-cache consistency hashes pre/post switch (alex)
- short-term: keep `runtime.force_single_kernel=true` on staging and schedule gradual canary to prod only after fixes (ops)

mira: starting rollback calibration run now: `calib-run --model redwood-mix-2b --mode baseline --out=calib/rollback-2026-03-18`

sam: I'll add pprof traces & kernel switch counters to dashboard. Also dumping quant scale histograms so we can see distribution. Quick note: there's a cluster of layers (14-19) hitting extreme scales.

jin: can someone bisect commit range? suspect the calibration code path change + kernel selection heuristics interact. I can bisect calibration commits if you give me the window.

alex: commit window: `b1a2...` -> `c4f9b2d`. I'll start binary search on staging with `eval-suite --quick-bisect --target=structured-json`.

mira: assigning: mira (rollback calib + repro), sam (telemetry/dashboard + pprof), alex (bisect + kernel-switch hash), jin (calib analysis). ETA: get initial findings in 4h.

ops-bot: Noted. Creating incident: INC-2026-0318-quant-calib-halluc-triage, severity=P2. Paging on-call if status not updated in 3h.

alex: small long-term ask: add unit that verifies kernel switch does not change KV cache hash for same model+input. That would catch this earlier.

mira: thanks — will paste first rollback results when done. For now, keeping thread pinned to eng-runtime. :mag: :spiral_notepad:
